knowledge.name: Synthetic initiative brief
knowledge.detail: One fictional initiative with driver, objective, stakeholders, scope, constraints and review date.

knowledge.name: Current-state component register
knowledge.detail: Seven fictional components with domain, owner and lifecycle status, two at end of support.

knowledge.name: Requirements and readiness checklist
knowledge.detail: Eight non-functional requirements with owners and a ten-point review-board checklist.

intelligence_processing.name: Design intake and plan
intelligence_processing.detail: Use when an architect hands over the design template, discovery notes and initiative brief and asks where to start.

intelligence_processing.name: Architecture vision draft
intelligence_processing.detail: Use when an architect asks for the vision: business driver, scope, stakeholders, impacted domains, constraints and review workgroups.

intelligence_processing.name: Current-state baseline
intelligence_processing.detail: Use when an architect asks what the current state looks like for the systems or components in scope.

intelligence_processing.name: Non-functional requirements matrix
intelligence_processing.detail: Use when someone asks which non-functional requirements apply, who owns each one, and where the gaps and variances are.

intelligence_processing.name: Target design and inventory delta
intelligence_processing.detail: Use when an architect asks for the target design and what changes in the component inventory.

intelligence_processing.name: Review-board readiness check
intelligence_processing.detail: Use when someone asks whether the design is ready for the review board, its confidence score or its gaps.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the six-skill Draft agent with two synthetic knowledge files; publishing is a separate gated step.

clients_user_interface.name: Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot access
clients_user_interface.detail: Conversational entry point for architects once approved production controls exist.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file SolutionDesignReviewAgent locally with deterministic routing.

management_reporting.name: Requirements matrix view
management_reporting.detail: Shows each requirement's criterion, owner and status with missing owners and variances called out.

management_reporting.name: Inventory delta view
management_reporting.detail: Lists new, changed and retired components to register after build.

management_reporting.name: Readiness scorecard
management_reporting.detail: Confidence score, severity-ranked gaps and the recommendation before the review board.

tools.name: Portable SolutionDesignReviewAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with six deterministic, read-only operations over synthetic data.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server that discovers the agent and exposes chat and health endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the six-skill package in Draft; explicit approval is required before publication.

tools.name: Approved document library
tools.detail: Cited production seam for templates and past designs; no live connection exists in the package.

tools.name: Component inventory (read-only seam)
tools.detail: Cited production seam for current-state components; the agent never registers changes.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Uses only the bundled fictional initiative; never browses or reads a live inventory.

supporting_features.name: Evidence-traced readiness
supporting_features.detail: Every failed check names the missing domain, requirement or response behind it.

supporting_features.name: Architect ownership
supporting_features.detail: Every section is a draft the architect edits; owners are suggested by people, not assigned by the agent.

supporting_features.name: No external side effects
supporting_features.detail: Never submits to the review board, registers inventory changes or sends a document.

supporting_features.name: Governance authority stays human
supporting_features.detail: Readiness, approval and variances are decided by the review board.
